---
title: "Data type (excluded)"
---

::: {.callout-warning}
**Excluded from the primary supplementary results.** Data type is not reported as a moderator in this book. This page documents the attempted refits and the exclusion decision.
:::

## What was attempted

The original `data_type` model (m09) had sparse, poorly behaved levels. A cleaned refit, **m09b**, dropped the `index` (n = 14) and `temperature` (n = 19) levels and reset the reference level to `linear`.

## Fitting status and exclusion

The m09b refit converged and completed, but still returned **5 of 8000 post-warmup transitions (0.06%) as divergent**.

**Decision:** m09 (data type) — both the original fit and the m09b refit — is excluded from the primary results. Both are retained in `outputs/models/` for reproducibility and are mentioned here for transparency, but are not summarized, plotted, or fed into the aggregated effect tables or publication figures.
